product.name: Velara NotePad Pro
product.description: The Velara NotePad Pro is a lightweight digital notepad designed for professionals and students alike. Measuring 22 × 30 cm, it features a durable aluminum frame, a matte glass display, and a responsive touch surface that supports stylus input. The device runs on a low‑power 5 W battery, providing up to 12 hours of continuous use. With 8 GB of internal storage and a USB‑C port, users can transfer documents quickly and keep their notes organized. Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity allows for wireless pairing with laptops and smartphones, making the NotePad Pro a versatile tool for on‑the‑go productivity.
